blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Audio language models pass speech and text through a single decoder.
We ask whether that decoder represents a distinctive feature in the same direction when a phoneme is heard and when it is read.
For minimal pairs of phonemes differing in one feature, we take the offset between the two members’ mean representations.
Averaging those offsets gives a direction for each stream, and we measure the cosine between the two.
Because the two streams already agree about arbitrary phoneme pairs, we compare every measure against a reference built from random pairings rather than against zero.
We apply this to 6 models, 7 features and 15 languages from 11 families.
Only voicing in the two Qwen2.5-Omni models exceeds that reference after correction for multiple testing, and the reference varies by a factor of seven between models.
In three of the six models, voicing has one direction in audio across the 14 languages with enough minimal pairs to measure it, and every language pair agrees in two of them.
The model family, not the model size, predicts which stream represents a feature.
blocks.zh:
音频语言模型通过单个解码器通过语音和文本.
我们问,当听到电话和读到电话时,这个解码器是否代表着同一方向的一个显著特征。
对于一个特点不同的最低限度的对电话,我们取两个成员平均陈述之间的抵消。
分析这些偏差为每条流提供了方向,我们测量两者之间的余弦。
因为两条溪流已经同意任意的对电话, 我们比较了每一个量度 与一个从随机对对而不是零建立的参照。
我们将此应用于来自11个家庭的6种模式、7种特征和15种语言。
在两个Quen2.5-Omni模型中,只有在经过多次测试的校正后,才会发出超过该参考值的发票,而且参考值在模型之间因7而异。
在6种模式中的3种中,发音在14种语言的音频中有一个方向,足够最小的对子进行测量,每一种语言对子都同意其中两种.
模型家族,而不是模型大小,预测的是哪条流代表着一个特征.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
An audio language model (ALM) receives speech through an audio encoder and text through a tokeniser, and both streams pass through one decoder.
We study whether that decoder represents a distinctive feature as one direction in both streams, or keeps a separate representation for each.
blocks.zh:
一个音频语言模型(ALM)通过一个音频编码器接收语音,通过一个代碼器接收文本,两个流都通过一个解码器.
我们研究这个解码器是作为两个流中的一个方向的一个显著特征,还是为每个流保持一个单独的代表。

blocks.en:
Work on self-supervised speech models suggests that distinctive features are encoded as directions.
Choi et al. [ 1 ] show that distinctive features behave additively in such models, so that the offset between [d] and [t], added to [p], gives [b].
Phonetic information in these models also has a characteristic depth profile [ 2 ] , and a multilingual one learns latent units shared across languages [ 3 ] .
ALAS [ 4 ] runs an ALM on audio and on the transcript of the same audio, scoring per layer how well an audio frame’s hidden state identifies the text token it corresponds to.
That measures the temporal binding between the two streams rather than the geometry of any one feature.
blocks.zh:
关于自我监督的语音模型的工作表明,显著的特征被编码为方向.
崔 al等编. [1] 表明这些模型中的特点具有添加性,因此在[p]中添加的[d]和[t]之间的抵消给予[b]。
这些模型中的语音信息还具有特征深度剖面[2],一个多语种能够学习不同语言之间共享的潜在单位[3].
ALAS [4] 在音频和同一音频的笔录上运行一个ALM,每层评分一个音频框的隐藏状态如何很好地识别它对应的文本符号.
这可以衡量两个流之间的时间约束,而不是任何一个特征的几何。

blocks.en:
We take minimal pairs of phonemes differing in one distinctive feature, in 15 languages from 11 families, and compare the direction of their offsets when the phonemes are heard and when they are read.
Every measure has a reference drawn from random pairings rather than a comparison against zero.
After correction for multiple testing, only voicing in the two Qwen2.5-Omni models exceeds that reference, which itself differs more between models than any feature effect does.
Three of the six models use one voicing direction in audio for every language in which voicing can be measured.
Which stream represents a feature is predicted by the model family and not by the model size.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个独特的特点,用来自11个家庭的15种语言,用最小的对电话进行对比,在听到电话和阅读电话时,比较其抵消方向。
每个度量法都有从随机配对中抽取的参照,而不是与零比对.
在经过多次测试的校正后,在两个Quen2.5-Omni模型中,只有开具的发票超过了这个参照,而这个参照本身在模型之间比任何特征效应都不同.
6种模式中,有3种对每种语言都使用一个语音表达方向,可以测量语音。
哪个流代表一个特征,是由模型家族预测的,而不是模型大小.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Corpus, languages and models
blocks.zh: 2.1 公司、语言和模型

blocks.en:
We draw phonemes from the Language Documentation Reference Corpus [ 5 ] .
It provides time-aligned segments of spoken narrative, labelled with a broad transcription in the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) .
We keep the rows that annotate speech and discard pauses and disfluency markers.
Its transcription needs some canonicalisation before a feature table reads it (e.g., an ASCII g appears across 26,272 occurrences where the IPA voiced velar stop is expected).
blocks.zh:
我们从语言文献参考公司抽取电话
它提供了口语叙事的时序部分,并在国际语音字母表(IPA)中贴上粗略的文字。
我们保留那些对演讲进行注释并丢弃暂停和不规则标记的行.
它的抄录在功能表读取它之前需要一些划线化(例如,一个ASCII g出现于26,272个事件,预计投资促进机构会发出信号。

blocks.en:
A language enters the study on three conditions:
(1) Its audio must be distributed with the corpus.
(2) Its segments must be linked to recordings.
(3) At least one of the 7 features in Table 1 must have three or more minimal pairs among phoneme types occurring at least 100 times, though two pairs suffice to measure a feature.
Forty of the 47 languages qualify.
We rank those by how many features meet that threshold, breaking ties in favour of a less represented family, and take the first 15. Table 1 lists them, across 11 families.
blocks.zh:
一种语言进入研究有三个条件:
(1) 其音频必须随体散发。
(2) 其部分必须与录音联系起来。
(3)表1中的7个特征中至少有一个必须至少有3个或更多个最小的对,在电话类型中至少发生100次,尽管两个对足以测量一个特征.
47种语言中有40种符合资格.
我们按多少个特征达到这一门槛,打破关系,让代表较少的家庭受益,采取前15个。 表1列出了11个家庭的情况。

blocks.en:
Phonemes are grouped into the utterance containing them.
A group’s span runs from its first phoneme’s start to its last phoneme’s end, so the audio a model receives contains every phoneme we then locate within it.

To map decoder position to time we encode clips of several durations and count the positions holding the model’s audio placeholder.

For the text stream we write the same group as an IPA string between slashes, as broad transcription conventionally is written and as dictionaries give it, and pass it through the same decoder.

We locate each occurrence by the character(s) it occupies, then average over every token whose span overlaps them, since a token may cover several symbols or only part of one.

blocks.en: 2.3 Feature directions from minimal pairs
blocks.zh: 2.3 最小对的特征方向

blocks.en:
Each phoneme is described by a vector of binary distinctive features, read from a feature table [ 25 ] .
A minimal pair is two phoneme types whose vectors differ in exactly one position.
We always subtract the member x i − x^{-}_{i} that lacks the feature from the member x i + x^{+}_{i} that has it, so that every pair of a feature is oriented alike.

我们总是减去成员x i - x  - X}_{i} 缺少成员x i + x^{+}_{i} 的特性, 拥有它, 这样一对特性都一样。

blocks.en: 2.4 What each measure is compared against
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 将每项措施与

blocks.en:
For arbitrary pairs, the distribution of A A is wider when there are fewer pairs, and that of c c is not centred on zero, because one pair’s offsets in audio and in text both reflect which phonemes the pair contains.
Neither distribution can be computed, so we build a reference by pairing at random, in the manner of a control task [ 28 ] .
For each of B = 2000 B=2000 repetitions we draw, uniformly and without replacement, as many pairs of distinct phoneme types as the feature itself has, and recompute the quantities above.
Each pair’s members are taken in the order drawn, so its orientation, like the pairing, does not come from a feature.
Within a repetition the same pairing is used on both streams, since pairing them independently would compare directions built from different phonemes and lower the reference.
With k k of the B B repetitions reaching the observed value, we report p = ( k + 1 ) / ( B + 1 ) p=(k+1)/(B+1) [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
对于任意配对,当配对较少时,A的分布会更宽,cc的配对不以0为中心,因为一对配对在音频和文本中均反映了配对中包含的电话.
两种分布都无法计算,因此我们以控制任务的方式,通过随机配对建立参考[28]。
对于B = 2000 B = 2000 重复,我们画,统一和不替换,像特性本身那样,多对不同的电话类型,并重新计算上述数量。
每对成员按所画的顺序排列,因此其方向与配对一样,并不来自一个特征.
在重复中,两条溪流都使用相同的配对,因为独立配对将比较不同电话所建方向并降低参考。
随着BB的kk重复达到观测值,我们报告p=(k+1)/(B+1)p=(k+1)/(B+1)[29].

blocks.en:
We also take the cosine of a feature’s audio direction with each other feature’s text direction.
The largest of those is its cross-feature value, and comparing c c against it asks whether the agreement is specific to that feature.
blocks.zh:
我们还把一个功能的音频方向与另一个功能的文本方向同心协力。
其中最大的是其跨地貌价值,并将cc与它比较,它询问协议是否具体针对这一特征.

blocks.en: 2.5 Testing across languages
blocks.zh: 2.5 不同语文的测试

blocks.en:
The language is our unit of replication.
For a feature we take the median c c over languages at each layer, then the largest of those medians.
The layer is not fixed in advance, since the depth at which the two streams agree most differs between models.
blocks.zh:
语言是我们复制的单位。
对于一个特征,我们把中位数c 相对于语言在每个层次, 然后最大的这些中位数。
地层不是事先固定的,因为两条流在深度上同意的模型差异最大.

blocks.en:
The reference therefore has to account for that choice.
The b b th repetition from section 2.4 uses its own pairing in every language and keeps it at every layer.
We then take the median over languages at each layer, and the largest of those medians.
The repetitions are independent across languages, so how they are paired does not matter.
We test every model against every feature, so we report a Benjamini–Hochberg q q [ 30 ] across those 42 tests alongside p p .
The fractions in Table 3 describe where a comparison holds across depth rather than adding hypotheses, so we leave their p p uncorrected.
blocks.zh:
因此,必须参照这一选择。
第2.4节中的b b t 重复使用自己在每种语言中的配对,并保留在每一层.
然后我们把中位数放在每层语言之上, 也是这些中位数中最大的。
重复语在语言上是独立的,所以如何对齐不重要.
我们对照每个特征测试每个模型,
表3中的分数描述了比较在哪些地方具有跨深度,而不是添加假设,所以我们没有更正它们的pp。

blocks.en:
We also ask whether a feature is one direction in a model or one per language, since a direction separating voiced from voiceless phonemes in one language might reflect that inventory rather than voicing in general.
For a feature and a stream, the across-language agreement is the mean cosine between the languages’ directions, which is Eq. 1 applied across languages rather than across the pairs of one feature.
Its reference shuffles, within each language, which feature each of that language’s directions belongs to.
Every language therefore keeps the directions it had, and only the correspondence of features between languages is destroyed.
blocks.zh:
我们还问一个特征是模式的一个方向还是每种语言的一个方向,因为从一种语言的无声电话中分离出来的一个方向可能反映这一清单,而不是一般的表达方式。
对于一个特性和一个流,跨语协议是语言方向之间的平均余弦,即Eq. 1适用于不同语言,而不是一个特性的对对。
在每种语言中,其参考语句都带有该语言的每个方向。
因此,每种语言都遵循其方向,只有各种语言之间的特征对应被摧毁。

blocks.en:
The models fall into two patterns ( Table 3 ).
A stream counts as representing a feature at a layer when A A there exceeds its reference, and the Wthn columns give the median over languages of that count, as a fraction of the model’s depth.
The two Qwen2.5-Omni models represent voicing when they hear it and not when they read it, at 0.84 and 0.85 of their layers versus no layers.
The Gemma models show the reverse for height and length, representing them at 0.39 to 1.00 of their layers when reading and at 0.00 to 0.08 when hearing.
blocks.zh:
这些模型分为两种模式(表3)。
当 A 超过 参考 时, 流 算作 代表 一层的特性, Wthn 列给出了 该 数 的 语言 , 作为 模型 深度 的 一小部分 。
两种Quen2.5-Omni模型在听到时而不是在阅读时代表发音,其分层的0.84和0.85对无层.
Gemma模型显示高度和长度的反向,在读取时代表它们分层0.39至1.00,在听觉时代表0.00至0.08.

blocks.en:
Each family includes two model sizes, so the family and not the size predicts which pattern a model shows.
The Qwen models initialise their audio encoder from Whisper [ 31 ] and train it against the decoder [ 6 , 7 ] , whereas Gemma uses a Conformer encoder that stays frozen throughout pre-training [ 8 ] .
With two families we cannot separate the effect of the encoder’s architecture from whether it was trained.
blocks.zh:
每个家族包括两个模型大小,所以家族而不是大小预测模型显示的图案.
Quen模式 将 Whisper [31] 的音频编码器关闭,并训练它对抗解码器 [6, 7], 而 Gemma 则使用 Conformer 编码器, 在整个预训练中保持冻结 [8] 。
我们无法将编码器结构的效果与它是否受过训练分开。

blocks.en:
Model size does not predict the median c c either.
For voicing the smaller model of each pair has the larger median c c , + 0.45 +0.45 against + 0.40 +0.40 in Qwen2.5-Omni and + 0.11 +0.11 against + 0.07 +0.07 in Gemma, while for height and length the larger Qwen2.5-Omni model has the larger median ( Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
模型大小也不预测中位数c c.
对于每对的较小的模型,在Quen2.5-Omni中,其中位数为cc,+0.45+0.45对+0.40+0.40,在Gemma中,+0.11+0.11对+0.07+0.07,而在高度和长度方面,较大的Quen2.5-Omni模型的中位数为较大的(表2)。

blocks.en:
The Acrs columns ask something else: whether a model uses one direction for a feature in every language, or a separate direction in each.
A single value exists per layer here, so those columns give the fraction of layers directly rather than a median over languages.
The two questions have different answers.
Gemma 4 E2B represents length when it hears it at only 0.01 of its layers, yet at 0.83 of them the languages agree on one length direction.
A language’s direction for a feature is the mean of several offsets, and a mean can point consistently even when the offsets it averages disagree with each other.
Representing a feature within a single language is therefore not a precondition for sharing a direction across languages.
blocks.zh:
Acrs栏另问:一个模型是用一个方向来表示每种语言的特征,还是用一个单独的方向来表示.
这里每层存在一个单一值,因此这些列直接给出了各层的分数,而不是语言上的中位数.
这两个问题有不同的答案。
Gemma 4 E2B只在其0.01层听到时表示长度,而其中0.83层的语言则同意一个长度方向.
一种语言对一个特征的方向是数个抵消的平均值,一个平均值可以一致指向,即使它的平均抵消是相互不一致的。
因此,在单一语文中代表一个特征并不是各语文共享方向的先决条件。

blocks.en: 3.3 One direction across languages, or one per language
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 跨语言的一个方向,或每个语言一个方向

blocks.en:
In three of the six models the languages’ voicing directions in audio agree more than the reference at every layer ( Table 3 ).
They agree at + 0.54 +0.54 and + 0.57 +0.57 in the two Qwen2.5-Omni models and at + 0.52 +0.52 in Audio-Flamingo 3, with that reference within 0.01 0.01 of zero.
In the two Qwen2.5-Omni models every one of the 91 language pairs agrees, the weakest at + 0.31 +0.31 , whereas two of Audio-Flamingo 3’s pairs point opposite ways.
Qwen2-Audio reaches + 0.49 +0.49 , but at only 10 of its 33 layers, and the two Gemma models reach + 0.19 +0.19 and + 0.15 +0.15 at one layer each.

In Audio-Flamingo 3 the median language has no layer at which its own voicing offsets exceed their reference, yet the languages agree with each other at every layer.
Across all models and features, a feature’s agreement within a language and its across-language agreement correlate at + 0.67 +0.67 in audio and + 0.73 +0.73 in text.
A model that represents a feature within languages usually shares a direction across them as well.
blocks.zh:
在Audio-Flamingo 3中,中位语言没有层层,在层层中其自身的发票抵消超过其参考,但语言在每一层中彼此一致。
在所有模型和特征中,一个特征在一种语言内达成的协议及其跨语言协议在音频中为+0.67+0.67,文本中为+0.73+0.73。
代表语言内部特征的模型通常也具有共同的方向。

blocks.en:
Length in text has the highest across-language agreement of any feature, + 0.88 +0.88 or higher in every model, and it peaks at the first or second layer in all six.
Length is the one feature represented by adding the length mark (:) rather than by changing a symbol, so the agreement is present in the token embeddings rather than built by the decoder.
A shared written mark can give a trivially shared direction, without any phonological knowledge.
blocks.zh:
文本的长度在任意特征的跨语言协议中最高,每个模型中均+0.88+0.88或更高,并且在所有6个模型中均在第一或第二层达到峰值.
长度是增加长度标记(:)而不是改变一个符号所代表的一个特征,因此协议存在于符号嵌入中,而不是由解码器构建.
一个共享的书面标记可以给出一个微不足道的共享方向,而没有任何声学知识.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
A feature’s offset uses every occurrence of one phoneme against every occurrence of another, so any systematic difference in where the two occur enters the offset, and the design cannot remove that.
We measure that difference as the distance between the two members’ distributions over neighbouring phonemes, and its correlation with c c is − 0.01 -0.01 for voicing, + 0.05 +0.05 for height and + 0.06 +0.06 for length.
At the embedding layer c c never exceeds + 0.10 +0.10 for any model or feature, so the voicing agreement in Qwen2.5-Omni is built by the decoder rather than inherited from the tokeniser.
Splitting every phoneme’s occurrences in two gives two estimates of each direction, agreeing at a median of 0.82 0.82 in audio and 0.96 0.96 in text, so most estimates are well determined even though the weakest are not.
blocks.zh:
一个功能的抵消使用一个电话的每次发生与另一个电话的每次发生,所以两者发生地点的任何系统差异都进入抵消,而设计无法消除这一点.
我们以两个成员在相邻电话上分布的距离来衡量这一差异,其与cc的关联性是:发票为0.01-0.01,高度为0.05+0.05,长度为0.06+0.06。
在嵌入层c c 对于任何型号或特征来说,从未超过+0.10+0.10,所以Quen2.5-Omni中的发音协议是由解码器建造的,而不是从代号器中继承的.
将每个电话的频率分成两个,对每个方向给出两个估计值,在音频中位数为0.82 0.82,文本中位数为0.96 0.96,因此,即使最弱者不是,大多数估计值还是很确定的。

blocks.en:
A model that mapped audio into a rotated copy of its text space would preserve every distance between phonemes while giving a generic direction zero cosine with its counterpart.
That is not what we observe for voicing in the two Qwen2.5-Omni models, though we cannot rule out a rotation that leaves some directions fixed.
A c c near zero elsewhere need not mean the two streams share no structure at all.
We check with representational similarity analysis (RSA) [ 32 ] , correlating the two streams’ phoneme-similarity matrices by rank against a reference that shuffles which phoneme corresponds to which.
This comparison needs no minimal pairs, so all 15 languages contribute, and every model has a layer at which they all exceed that reference.
blocks.zh:
将音频映射到其文本空间的旋转副本的模型将保持电话之间每一距离,同时与对应方给出通用方向零余弦.
我们观察的不是在两个Quen2.5-Omni模型中发表言论的情况,尽管我们不能排除使某些方向固定的旋转。
a c 接近于零的别处不一定意味着两条流完全没有结构。
我们用代表性相似性分析(RSA)[32],
这种比较不需要最小的对数,所以所有15种语言都贡献了,每个模型都有一层,它们都超过了这个参考.

blocks.en:
Both directions in c c are taken at the same layer, and in 12 of the 18 combinations in Table 3 no layer has a majority of languages exceeding the reference in both streams.
A feature encoded early in audio and late in text would therefore read as absent, and ruling that out needs a search over pairs of layers.
blocks.zh:
c中的两种方向都在同一层,在表3的18种组合中的12种中,无层语言的多数超过两个流的引用.
因此,音频早期和文本晚期编码的功能将被读作缺失,并排除需要对一对层进行搜索。

blocks.en:
After correction, agreement between the two streams holds only for voicing and only in the two Qwen2.5-Omni models, where comparing against zero would have found it in 15 of the 42 combinations instead.
Agreement across languages is wider.
In three of the six models the languages agree on one voicing direction in audio.
blocks.zh:
经过修正,两条溪流之间的协议只涉及发票,仅在两个Quen2.5-Omni模型中,与之相比,在42种组合中的15种中就能找到。
各语文之间的协议范围更广。
在6种模式中的3种模式中,语言同意用音频表达一个方向。
